collectibles.name: Film Roll
collectibles.how: One in each of the 65 main levels.
collectibles.spend: Filling in the comics at Fanzine H.Q. levels.

collectibles.name: (EN)Zine
collectibles.how: Not in the levels: you fill in a comic at a Fanzine H.Q. with film rolls.

collectibles.name: Onsen
collectibles.how: Secret levels, unlocked by finding an alternate exit in certain levels. Just dialogue and lore.

collectibles.name: Dare
collectibles.how: Challenges in each of the 65 main levels, from 'get X score' to 'hit X thing'. Some are about collecting the other items.

facts: Nothing is missable. You can go back to any level at any point, and everything can be done after finishing the game.
A Fanzine H.Q. cannot be completed on your first visit, because you need film rolls from later levels. Come back after collecting every film roll in the chapter.
An onsen only unlocks if you find the alternate exit in its level (for example 1-6-1 for 1-6-O, and the end of 3-1-2 for 3-1-O).
